#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
DEST=/var/backups/inventory
SOURCE_HOST=10.100.64.11
IDENTITY=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519
KNOWN_HOSTS=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
STAMP=$(date +%F)
ARCHIVE="$DEST/inventory-$STAMP.tar.gz"
TMP=$(mktemp "$DEST/.inventory-$STAMP.tmp.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
exec 9>/run/inventory-backup.lock
/usr/bin/flock -n 9
/usr/bin/ssh -i "$IDENTITY" \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" \
  -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
  root@"$SOURCE_HOST" > "$TMP"
/usr/bin/tar -tzf "$TMP" >/dev/null
chmod 0600 "$TMP"
mv -f "$TMP" "$ARCHIVE"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
find "$DEST" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete
printf 'inventory backup complete: %s\n' "$ARCHIVE"
ANTRIEB_EOF
